purpose: C500 BF16 kernel adaptation with source-level layout and epilogue optimizations; no framework merge
adaptation: BF16 inputs and outputs, existing N128/K64 packed weight layout, optional rounded SwiGLU fusion, shared-memory transpose for coalesced stores in gate/up, output projection and down projection
local_tail_optimization: On C500 with104 logical SMs, Down GEMM M1921..2048,N2048,K6144 splits only the final48 tiles in K. Partial accumulators remain FP32; BF16 rounding follows FP32 summation. Shared-memory transpose coalesces partial writes. Full tiles retain the original BF16 epilogue.
